description:
Creates a Space as specified in the payload.

Available on tenants with [Role-Based Access Control](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/manage-user-roles/). 

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to create spaces.

201.description: Returned if the requested space is created.

base.description: Base url of the Confluence site.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description: Returned if the calling user does not have permission to create spaces.

413.description: Returned if the request is too large in size (over 5 MB).
